input: Test and replace all smoke detector batteries

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the total number of detectors determines the scale of the task and how many batteries to buy.
The location (single home, multi-floor building, rental property) affects access, logistics, and whether a ladder is needed.
Knowing whether any detectors are hardwired vs. battery-only changes what the replacement step actually involves.
Whether replacement batteries are already on hand determines if a shopping trip is needed before starting.
Knowing if this is for the user alone or coordinating with housemates/tenants affects scheduling and who needs to be notified about alarm tests.
Whether the goal is just battery replacement or also includes checking expiry dates and replacing aging detector units changes the definition of done.
A preferred target date (e.g., tied to a seasonal reminder or move-in) helps prioritise urgency and schedule the task.

gold.taskTitle: Test and replace all smoke detector batteries
gold.taskDescription: Check every smoke detector in the home, test that each unit works, and replace batteries as needed.

questions.title: How many smoke detectors are in your home?
questions.description: The total count determines the scale of the task and exactly how many replacement batteries to purchase.

questions.title: Are the detectors battery-only or hardwired with backup batteries?
questions.description: Hardwired units require an extra step to disconnect power before replacing the backup battery, changing the procedure.

questions.title: Which rooms or floors are the detectors located on?
questions.description: Knowing the locations helps map out the task route and flag any that require a ladder or special access.

questions.title: Do you already have replacement batteries at home?
questions.description: If batteries are not on hand, a shopping trip becomes the immediate first action before anything else can proceed.

questions.title: Will you need to notify anyone before testing the alarms?
questions.description: Housemates, family members, or tenants may need advance warning so the alarm sound does not cause alarm or disruption.

questions.title: Should expired or aging detector units also be replaced, not just batteries?
questions.description: Smoke detectors over 10 years old should be fully replaced; knowing if this is in scope defines what 'done' looks like.

questions.title: Is there a specific date you want this completed by?
questions.description: A target date (e.g., before a trip, seasonal check, or move-in) sets the urgency and helps schedule the task appropriately.
